_meta.source: MassGIS Environmental Justice Populations 2020 (block groups), joined to 2020 tracts
_meta.fields: tracts: tract GEOID → [ejBlockGroups, ejPopulation, pctMinority, limEngHouseholdPct, medianBlockGroupIncome]; blockgroups: tract GEOID → [[blockGroupDigit, pctMinority, limEngHouseholdPct, medianIncome, households], …]
_meta.aggregation: Minority share is population weighted and limited-English share household weighted, across the EJ block groups of that tract only. Median income is the mean of block-group medians, not a true tract median.
_meta.joinKey: Block-group GEOID is the 11-digit tract GEOID plus its single-digit block group, so the join needs no geometry.
_meta.coverage: This layer publishes EJ-designated block groups only: 2604 rows, all EJ="Yes", across 187 municipalities. It is NOT every Massachusetts block group, so the percentages describe EJ block groups, never the whole tract. Divide ejPopulation by the tract population in ma-tract-stats.json to get the EJ share of a tract.
_meta.caveat: EJ2020 flags are the state's 2020 criteria (minority, income, English isolation), not a 2026 determination.
